map.在 Cp 之外进一步纳入均值偏移，给出过程实际能稳定产出合格品的能力，是供方准入: Beyond Cp it further incorporates the mean offset and gives the capability the process can actually sustain within specification; it is the single most common criterion for supplier approval and customer acceptance.
map.当过程均值因设备磨损、温漂等偏离规格中心时，用 Cpk 量化偏移造成的合格品率损: When the process mean drifts from the center of the specification because of tool wear or thermal drift, use Cpk to quantify the loss of yield caused by the offset.
map.没有统一铁律，取决于行业与客户：一般制造业 ≥1.33，汽车/医疗/航空常要求: There is no universal rule; it depends on the industry and the customer: manufacturing usually requires >=1.33, while automotive, medical and aerospace often require >=1.67 and critical safety parts even more. Below 1.0 the process is usually considered incapable and must be corrected before batch delivery.
map.监控改进措施（如重新对刀、调平夹具）前后的能力变化，验证纠偏有效。: Monitor the capability change before and after improvement measures (such as re-setting the tool or levelling the fixture) to verify that the correction worked.
map.过程只能以『更受限的一侧』为准：若均值偏上，超出上限的风险更大；偏下则低于下限风: The process can only be judged by the more constrained side: if the mean runs high the risk of exceeding the upper limit is greater; if it runs low, the risk of falling below the lower limit is greater. Taking min conservatively uses the worst side as the overall capability so the nicer number on the other side cannot hide it.
map.：Cpk = min[(USL − μ)/(3σ), (μ − LSL)/(3σ: : Cpk = min[(USL - μ)/(3σ), (μ - LSL)/(3σ)], taking the smaller of the upper and lower one-sided capability indices, representing the side suppressed by the offset. σ is the within-group standard deviation and μ is the process mean. Verdict: Cpk >= 1.33 is sufficient (most automotive industries require >=1.33 or higher); 1.00 <= Cpk < 1.33 is marginal; Cpk < 1.00 is insufficient and needs improvement; Cpk >= 2.0 is Six Sigma class (a 1.5σ offset corresponds to about 3.4 DPMO).
map.：轴径规格 10±0.05（USL=10.05、LSL=9.95），μ=10.0: : shaft diameter spec 10±0.05 (USL=10.05, LSL=9.95), μ=10.0, σ=0.01: Cpk = min[(10.05-10.0)/(3x0.01), (10.0-9.95)/(3x0.01)] = min[0.05/0.03, 0.05/0.03] = min[1.667, 1.667] = 1.667, equal to Cp because the mean is centered. If tool wear drifts μ to 10.02: Cpk = min[(10.05-10.02)/0.03, (10.02-9.95)/0.03] = min[1.000, 2.333] = 1.000, so even with unchanged variation the offset has pushed capability below 1.33.
